name: a webhook retry review that follows the change into the dashboard and the tests

review.pr: Retry failed webhook deliveries three times

comments.text: The backoff multiplies the delay by the attempt count, so the third attempt waits 15 minutes while the issue asks for 25. Worth matching the issue here, or changing the issue.
A delivery that is retried keeps its original timestamp, so the dashboard shows the first attempt as the delivery time. Support reads that column every day and it will mislead them.
Could you add a case where the third attempt fails as well? That is the path support will see most often.

review.summary: Read the retry path, the worker loop and the new tests, and ran the suite locally. Two things to fix before merge, both small, and the shape of the change looks right to me.

name: a review of the changed loop that finds a page dropped

review.pr: Add pagination to the orders export

comments.text: The loop stops when a page has fewer than 100 rows, but the API returns 99 on a full page when one row is filtered out, so the export ends early and drops the remaining pages. Loop until next_cursor is empty instead.
The catch on line 58 swallows the rate limit error and returns an empty page. Rethrow it so the retry wrapper sees it.
